Yes. I want to make sure everything is on track.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, everything else looks right.
The security wait is about twenty minutes. Are you leaving soon?
Yes, I am heading to the airport shortly.
Is Denver your final destination?
Denver is the only part of the trip I need help with right now.
Do you have any dietary or accessibility needs?
No, nothing like that.
Are you checking any bags?
Just one checked bag.
Is the contact phone number on your booking current?
Yes, it is current.
Do you need directions to the departure terminal?
No, I know where to go.
Would you like gate-change notifications sent to your phone as a text message?
Yes, that would help.
Do you already have a seat assignment?
Yes, fourteen C, an aisle.
Is the rewards number ending in 993 yours?
Yes, that is mine.
I will Enable active monitoring for changes to the itinerary.
Okay, I will watch for what happens.
